cli-recorded-run.caption: A worker run recorded with --record, and its evidence. The semantic index needs a local embedding model and is not shown.

cli-arena.label: Blind arena
cli-arena.alt: Terminal: arena show for a finished match in which two contenders, both gpt-6-luna as an A/A match, each made the Kelvin conversion in temperature.mjs clearer in its own worktree. The match is shown blind as A and B with the vote command; each contender has its exit status, turns, tool calls, writes and a one-file diff summary, then its final report, which notes the existing absolute-zero test failure it left unchanged, and its diff: A adds a comment, B adds a named absolute-zero constant. No research campaign is shown: a campaign runs for many minutes and was not run for this capture.
cli-arena.caption: A blind A/A arena match on gpt-6-luna: two answers labelled A and B, with their diffs, before anyone votes.
